entries.what: Got home from the Monday night shift on 4 West at 7:45 a.m., fell asleep around 8:30 with the box fan and blackout curtains.
Checked the card-only laundry room balance at Marisol Gardens and worked out a laundry routine that fits a three-night week, tracking the card reload.
entries.outcome: Settled on laundry on her off days before shifts.

entries.what: Made a thermos of cà phê sữa đá, packed rice and leftovers, and took the nurse shuttle up Ortega Hill for the night shift.
Worked a 12-hour night on 4 West with Jasmine and Rubén; Hana next door started back at her job today, so 209 was quiet when Thao left.
Finished the Monday night shift, ate leftover rice, and slept 8:30 to 3 with earplugs against noise through the 209 wall.
Election Day: walked to the Vinca Avenue Community Center and voted on council seats and Measure K before heading to Ruiz Family Market for produce and fish sauce.
Packed up and rode the shuttle for another Tuesday night shift on 4 West.
Came home post-shift, slept, then texted Jasmine to lock in the shift swap: off Nov 26-28 for Thanksgiving, working Christmas Eve instead.
Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop in the afternoon fog and had a late meal.
Called nobody back, let Hạnh's voicemail sit, and watched her baking show before bed.
Off day. Slept in, did laundry at Marisol Gardens with the reloaded card, and watered the pothos and basil on the balcony.
Had dinner with Tomás after his apprentice day; he made another giant pot of chili and left the pot soaking.
entries.outcome: Washed the pot herself, said nothing.

entries.what: Texted Linh to check in about her coursework before bed.
Friday: slept in after a late night, then prepped for the shift with a thermos and packed rice.
Took the shuttle up Ortega Hill and worked a night on 4 West; Rubén's sheet helped with a charting hiccup.
Drove past the Ortega Playhouse on the way home and saw families arriving for the Flats High fall play.
Got home after the night shift and ate phở tái at Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine.
At 8 a.m. finished her last continuing-ed hours online and submitted the RN license renewal; asked the assistant for the quick confirm steps and got a one-line answer.
Slept through the afternoon with the fan on.
Sunday: woke, texted Linh a small congratulations-on-surviving-the-week message, and sent nothing more.
Went to Hạnh's Pell Road house for the every-other-week Sunday dinner and ate whatever her mother put out.
entries.outcome: Brought home leftovers for shift lunches.

entries.what: Back home, laid out navy scrubs and set the box fan up for the week.
